sloka: जाह्नवीतीरमासाद्य चिराभिलषितं मम ।हर्षकाले किमर्थं मां विषादयसि लक्ष्मण ।। ७.४६.२६ ॥
transliteration: jāhnavītīramāsādya cirābhilaṣitaṁ mama ।harṣakāle kimarthaṁ māṁ viṣādayasi lakṣmaṇa ।। 7.46.26 ॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, why do you make me sad at this joyful moment, when we have reached the bank of the Ganga, which I have desired for so long?
